Verified: default permission mode for new threads is full (DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE in services/threads/thread-default-policy.ts), the factory default reasoning level is medium, and bb-app 0.43.1 has no settings general command, so model and effort can only be set from the composer pickers or in a seeded bb.db.

UNRESOLVED: model and effort defaults for new threads are stored in ~/.gui-cloudroom/bb.db (projectExecutionDefaults) and are only written by a thread created from the app. Set them once in the GUI (model picker Cmd+Shift+M, reasoning Alt+T) or restore a seeded bb.db before the night.

Telemetry: PostHog (BB_POSTHOG_API_KEY) plus Cloudroom's own setup snapshot (services/cloudroom/setup-telemetry.ts, five seconds after start). Both are gated by BB_TELEMETRY at server start and by the telemetryEnabled setting, and 0.43.1 exposes no CLI for either; turn it off in Settings > General or set BB_TELEMETRY=false in the app's launch environment.

Auto-update: electron-updater is enabled on macOS with autoDownload false and autoInstallOnAppQuit true unless the app bundle is not writable, so a downloaded update installs on quit and changes the version under the gate. No setting disables it.

Onboarding: the setup guide shows while onboardingCompletedAt is null, which is the case after every reset, and 0.43.1 has no replay-onboarding or settings general command to pre-set it. Dismiss it with the Skip setup button or a key found in the GUI session.

Claude runs through the bundled provider-claude-code of bb-app 0.43.1: BB_CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE if set, else claude from PATH (findCliExecutable), i.e. the system Claude Code 2.1.303. Cloudroom may offer to install Claude Code with Anthropic's installer if none is found; make sure claude is on the launchd PATH first. Codex runs through codex app-server.

Cloudroom's own agent plumbing: one system prompt for every thread (standardAgentAppendInstructions, toggle systemPromptEnabled) that tells agents to spawn subagents only through room-cli thread spawn --parent-self, and never through native Task or Codex subagents. C1 therefore needs no special mode; orchestrationTrigger /cloudroom is an ESTIMATE for the builtin CLI skill slash command.
steerActiveThreadOnEnter defaults false, so Enter on a running thread queues the message instead of steering it; C2 records that behavior, do not change it.
commandGuardEnabled defaults true, so the agent's shell commands may be checked before they run; watch C1 for a refused command.
New threads get a managed worktree under the project's environment folder in ~/.gui-cloudroom, so waitDone uses cwd any under ~.

The only URL scheme route is cloudroom://share/<id>, which copies a shared thread and needs the cloud account; it is not usable for openProject. Keep C1 off cloud machines: no --machine cloud, no Teleport.
